approaches.name: epidemiological surveillance and emergency operations intelligence system
approaches.description: The project uses upgraded surveillance and emergency operations center systems to detect COVID-19 cases, trace contacts, screen points of entry and speed response. Practices: COVID-19 surveillance system with active case detection, contact tracing and point-of-entry screening; Public Health Emergency Operations Center epidemiology intelligence system upgrade.
approaches.why_innovative: Digital core: activated COVID-19 surveillance system | New: emergency case detection and tracing infrastructure | Adoption: 'will include' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Surveillance activities will include: (a) activating the COVID-19 surveillance system;

extra_evidence.text: (b) implementing active case identification and contact tracing; and (c) implementing screening at Points of Entry (i.e.
IHR- designated air, land and sea ports).

Specifically, support will be provided to the following activities: (a) EOC: Support for expanding the scope and improving the functionality of the Public Health EOC, including, inter alia, upgrading the system for epidemiology intelligence, information gathering and use, and rapid response, improving risk communication and community engagement, and capacity building of DGHS including IEDCR.

category.rationale: Technological: surveillance and tracing system is the core mechanism

sector.rationale: Surveillance, case detection, and screening are core public health administration functions.
